prompt:
Create one continuous 5-second real-time candid iPhone clip, vertical 9:16, native 1080p. Reference image 0 is the accepted opening keyframe and the sole visual source for the adult woman's identity, body, clothing and location. Keep her exact face, facial proportions, skin tone, age, center-part long black hair, hairline and natural body proportions throughout. Preserve the exact clothing already visible in the keyframe. The performance must feel like a real person responding to an ordinary moment, not a model following choreography. Use one motivated action sequence with natural cause and effect: eyes notice the target first, the head follows, shoulders and torso respond subtly, the hand completes the task, then the body releases tension. Include irregular natural blinking, breathing, tiny facial asymmetry, loose hair response and believable cloth compression. Boyfriend-perspective phone camera: restrained handheld observation with small human drift that gently follows the action; never perform an automatic push-in, beauty zoom, orbit or sudden reframe. Keep the face and full action visible. Real skin texture, phone noise, modest compression and natural mixed light. No outfit change, second person, captions, watermark, dialogue or music. Avoid puppet motion, isolated head or hand movement, frozen torso, repeated gesture, prolonged posing, exaggerated smile, identity drift, extra fingers, broken joints, floating feet, prop morphing or background warping.
She is in the lived-in apartment kitchen wearing the grey sleeveless zipped athletic vest, black mid-thigh biker shorts and white sneakers. She has just heard her companion near the camera while her right hand rests on the clear capped water bottle. Over five seconds, her eyes shift toward the voice, her head and upper chest follow by a small natural amount, then she lifts the bottle cleanly off the table to waist height. Her wrist supports the bottle vertically; water moves subtly and the bottle keeps one stable shape. Her weight shifts slightly into the planted rear foot and the free knee relaxes. She gives a brief unplanned half-smile toward the companion, then looks toward the doorway as if ready to leave. The camera makes only a tiny human correction to keep her full body framed. No walking, drinking, repeated bottle lift, garment tugging or large zoom.
